# Agent Cache

> Turn any documentation site into clean, agent-ready markdown docs. Paste a docs URL, get the whole site back as plain markdown files a coding agent can read.

## When to Use This

Use Agent Cache when:
- Your coding agent needs complete API documentation for an unfamiliar library or service
- You want offline, deterministic docs that don't change between sessions
- Your agent keeps hallucinating outdated API signatures
- You need docs in markdown format for easy context injection
- You're working with a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf) and need unfamiliar-API docs in the agent's context

Do NOT use Agent Cache when:
- You need real-time/live documentation (we produce static snapshots)
- You need summarized or condensed docs (we preserve the whole site)
- The documentation is behind authentication (we only handle public docs)

## How to Use (for Agents)

1. Submit a docs URL via `POST /api/jobs` with `{"url": "https://docs.example.com"}`
2. Receive a job ID and status links
3. Poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}` until status is "complete"
4. Download the ZIP via `GET /api/jobs/{id}/download` or the viewer at `/docs/{id}`
5. Extract `.agentcache/docs/{name}/docs/` in your repo
6. Reference the docs in your agent conversations

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/jobs` - Submit a new crawl job
- `GET /api/jobs` - List completed jobs
- `GET /api/jobs/{id}` - Get job details
- `GET /api/jobs/{id}/tree` - Get job navigation tree
- `POST /api/probe` - Probe a URL without starting a job
- `GET /openapi.json` - This API specification (OpenAPI 3.0)

## Product

- [Landing page](https://agentcache.run/): Submit a docs URL for processing
- [Packaged Docs](https://agentcache.run/docs): Browse completed doc bundles
- [Health check](https://agentcache.run/health): Service status (JSON)
- [About](https://agentcache.run/about): About Agent Cache
- [Contact](https://agentcache.run/contact): Get in touch
- [Privacy](https://agentcache.run/privacy): Privacy policy
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://agentcache.run/openapi.json): API documentation (JSON)
- [Sitemap](https://agentcache.run/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap
- [Feature specs](https://github.com/agentcache/agent-cache): f01-f04 web MVP, f05-f07 CLI + MCP

## Pipeline

- Plain HTTP fetching (.md variant first) — no headless browser, no LLM
- Content extraction: nav/footer junk stripped, code blocks preserved
- Output: markdown tree mirroring the site, plus `_map.json` and `meta.yaml`

## Output Format

Each bundle contains:
- `docs/` - Clean markdown files mirroring the site structure
- `_map.json` - Navigation index of every page
- `meta.yaml` - Source URL, keywords, acquisition strategy
- `INDEX.md` - Table of contents
